about_the_game:
Thousands of citizens, thousands of stories.

From the morning rush to the late-night glow, your city is alive with thousands of citizens, each following their own routines. They work 9-to-5 jobs across industrial and commercial sectors, clock in at factories, deliver goods, and make their way home after dark through the streets you design.

Organic Movement

All your citizens move organically through your city, queuing at supermarkets, discos, and other public spaces. Optimize pedestrian flow or risk impatient crowds blocking your streets. Watch as lines form at buildings, parks fill with visitors, and stadiums come alive with cheering fans.

Dynamic Lives

After long workdays, citizens decide how to spend their leisure time based on their needs and desires - visiting museums, cinemas, resorts, or spas. Providing opportunities for leisure and wellness prevents burnout and keeps them healthy.

Global Tourism

Tourists from nearby cities explore your city and leave personal ratings based on their experiences. From sunny sightseeing trips downtown to nightlife strolls near hotels, your city’s reputation depends on meeting their expectations.

Corporate Drama

A boardroom of corporate executives monitors your progress, evaluating your performance as you strive to become the next great Urbanist. Fulfill their requests to keep the board satisfied - or risk losing their support!

Physical Economy

Every resource is produced, delivered, and consumed by hand, from residential, commercial, and industrial activity to energy, logistics, and engineering services.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 1.7 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R9 380 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 2.9 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070, Radeon RX 5700 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Thousands of citizens, each with a life of their own. Build a vintage capital city that provides commercial services from nightlife activities to luxurious tourism. Urbanist is a city-building game featuring mass population simulation, organic movement and physical resource simulation.
supported_languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
